notes.title: Kokoro Ultimate released for MacOS & Keybinding now available
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

Just checking in to announce the arrival of two new updates. First and foremost, the Mac version of Kokoro Ultimate is now available to download. While it is currently unclear if other versions will arrive, both Windows and macOS devices are here to stay. 

Second, the rise of non-QWERTY keyboards has prompted us to add a keybinding feature to the game. This way players can play using the keyboard in whichever fashion suits them. We have much more planned this year including the previously teased "Nightmare Mode"

Best Regards,
OMAGX Studios
DreamMakerz Inc

notes.title: Update v1.01 - Menu Fixes/Tutorial Upgrades
notes.content:
First and foremost, thank you to everyone that has streamed and uploaded Kokoro Ultimate this week. It means a lot to see discussion regarding our game. 

Today marks the first official Kokoro Ultimate update (Update v1.01) 

I noticed some players mentioned controller issues while navigating the main menu. I have provided a fix in the latest build that should take care of those issues.

Second, The tutorial had moments in which using backward/forward keys were not clear enough. They will now change depending on where you are facing.

The last thing I wanted to talk about was the price change. As you can see, the game is now set to $15. Chris and I are holding off on the full price of the game until Nightmare mode and Online Multiplayer are fully implemented. We want players to know their purchase was well worth it. Starting today, the price for the default version of the game will stay $15 until further updates.


Thanks again,
Chadrick
